**JOJO Server 1.2.0** - a free local web server for Windows.

## New in this version
- Apache as an alternative to Nginx (with `.htaccess` support). Switch in Settings.
- New project wizard: Laravel, WordPress and Symfony.
- Wildcard domains, a mail catcher, a log viewer, background workers and public share links.
- Composer and Node.js in every project terminal.

## How to install
1. Download **JOJO-Server_1.2.0_x64-setup.exe** below and run it.
2. Windows may say "Unknown publisher" because the installer is not code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. On the Dashboard click **Install recommended stack**, then **Start All**.

Requires 64-bit Windows 10 or 11. MIT license. Report problems in [Issues](https://github.com/hridoysarker6/jojo-server/issues).
